decision: Kenny: flag them. A formula using a supplier base whose composition is not published gets a named warning in the IFRA safety gate, never a block. Restricted substances inside these bases are not counted toward any IFRA total.
scope: Owned supplier bases and supplier extracts only, by their stock names in inventory.txt. A base leaves this list when its composition (an IFRA certificate or a published constituent list) is recorded.

bases.name: Costus Olifac
bases.reason: IFF costus reconstitution base. IFF's 2020 FPIS declares 69.25% (triethyl citrate 65.935%, guaiacwood oil 3.158%, traces) but not the costus odorants; its restricted traces (styrax 0.011%, isoeugenol 0.004%, furfural 0.002%) are not counted, and would cap the neat base at 27.5% (isoeugenol), far above any use. Physics: data/regulatory/partly_declared_bases.json.
